query:
SELECT 
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(valor),0) FROM lancamento_custo WHERE periodoCustoId = 30002) as lanc_custo,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(valor),0) FROM lancamento_salario WHERE periodoCustoId = 30002) as lanc_salario,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(valor),0) FROM lancamento_custo WHERE periodoCustoId = 30002) + (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(valor),0) FROM lancamento_salario WHERE periodoCustoId = 30002) as total
